nodes.description: rewardToken: address of the ERC20 token paid out as proposal reward.
governance: address called with a low-level call to fetch proposal data; owner-controlled but used as external call target.
idTreshold: minimum proposal id required before a reward can be claimed.
reward: reward amount in rewardToken units paid per rewarded proposal.
rewardedPropolsals: mapping marking proposal ids that already received a reward.
_owner: private owner address inherited from Ownable used by onlyOwner.
PropolsalRewarder constructor: initializes governance, rewardToken, reward and idTreshold.
setReward(uint256): onlyOwner setter that writes the reward amount.
setGovernance(address): onlyOwner setter that writes the governance address.
withdrawLeftovers(address): onlyOwner function transferring the full rewardToken balance to an arbitrary address.
getPropolsalReward(uint256): validates proposal, marks it rewarded, external-calls governance, decodes result in assembly and transfers reward.
receive(): payable fallback that always reverts to refuse ether.
owner(): view returning the current owner address.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function setting owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == msg.sender before executing the guarded function.
msg.sender: caller identity used for the owner check and compared with the proposal proposer.
IERC20(rewardToken).transfer(msg.sender, reward): external token transfer executed inside getPropolsalReward after an external call.
address(governance).call(payload): arbitrary low-level external call with encoded calldata and unchecked target/return.
assembly mload decoding of proposer/executed from returnData without validating return data length.
IERC20(rewardToken).transfer(_to, balanceOf(this)): external token transfer of the entire balance in withdrawLeftovers.
_governance constructor parameter assigned to state_governance.
_rewardToken constructor parameter assigned to state_rewardToken.
_reward constructor parameter assigned to state_reward.
_idTreshold constructor parameter assigned to state_idTreshold.
_newReward parameter written into state_reward by setReward.
_newGovernance parameter written into state_governance by setGovernance.
_to recipient address of the leftover token transfer in withdrawLeftovers.
pid proposal id used for the threshold check and the rewarded mapping.
newOwner parameter written into state_owner by transferOwnership.
payload: abi.encodeWithSignature bytes used as calldata for the governance call.
success: boolean result of the low-level governance call required to be true.
returnData: raw bytes returned by the governance call and decoded via assembly.
proposer: address decoded from returnData and compared with msg.sender.
executed: bool decoded from returnData and required to be true before paying the reward.
